# EDS Block Validator — Rules Reference

This document defines every rule enforced by `src/validator.ts`.
Use it to review pull requests that add or modify EDS blocks.

---

## How to use (GitHub Copilot agent)

When reviewing a PR that touches files inside `blocks/<block-name>/`, apply every rule below to the changed files and report violations as inline review comments using the format:

```
Rule: <rule-id>  
Severity: error | warning | info  
File: <file>  
Message: <message>  
Fix: <fix>   ← include only when a fix is specified
```

A block **passes** when it has zero `error`-severity violations.  
Score = `max(0, 100 − errors×15 − warnings×5 − infos×2)`

---

## JavaScript rules (`<block-name>.js`)

| Rule ID | Severity | Condition | Message | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `js-missing` | error | File does not exist | Missing block.js file — every EDS block needs a JS file with decorate() | — |
| `js-no-decorate` | error | Neither `export default function decorate` nor `export default async function decorate` found | Missing required: export default function decorate(block) | Add: `export default function decorate(block) { ... }` |
| `js-missing-block-param` | error | `export default function decorate()` found (no param) | decorate() must accept block parameter: decorate(block) | Change to: `export default function decorate(block) { ... }` |
| `js-global-query` | error | `document.querySelector(` or `document.querySelectorAll(` present **and** no `block.querySelector` / `block.querySelectorAll` present | Use block.querySelector() instead of document.querySelector() to avoid cross-block conflicts | Replace `document.querySelector` with `block.querySelector` |
| `js-mixed-query-scope` | warning | Both `document.querySelector` **and** `block.querySelector` present | Found document.querySelector with block.querySelector — prefer block-scoped queries only | — |
| `js-fetch-in-decorate` | warning | Both `fetch(` and `await` present | Async fetch() in decorate() may delay rendering | — |
| `js-innerhtml-fetch` | warning | Both `innerHTML` and `fetch(` present | Setting innerHTML from fetched content is an XSS risk — use DOM APIs | — |
| `js-framework-import` | error | Any of: `from "react"`, `from 'react'`, `from "vue"`, `from 'vue'`, `from "@angular`, `from '@angular` | Framework import detected (`<pattern>`). EDS blocks must use vanilla JS | — |
| `js-npm-import` | error | `from '<pkg>'` where `<pkg>` does not start with `.`, `/`, or `http` | npm import detected: `"<pkg>"`. EDS has no node_modules runtime | Remove the import or use a CDN URL |
| `js-document-write` | error | `document.write` present | document.write() is forbidden in EDS | — |
| `js-storage-forbidden` | error | `localStorage` or `sessionStorage` present | localStorage/sessionStorage are forbidden in EDS blocks | Use data attributes, CSS classes, or URL params for state |
| `js-multi-instance-break` | error | `document.querySelector` targeting `.<block-name>` class | document.querySelector('.<block-name>') breaks with multiple instances — use block.querySelector() | — |
| `js-multiple-default-exports` | error | More than one `export default (async )? function` | Multiple default exports detected — each block must have one decorate() export | — |
| `js-img-lazy-missing` | warning | `createElement('img')` or `createElement("img")` present **and** `loading` absent | Dynamically created img should include loading="lazy" and dimensions | — |
| `js-size-budget` | warning | JS file size > 10 240 bytes | Block JS is `<N>`KB — recommended under 10KB | — |

---

## CSS rules (`<block-name>.css`)

| Rule ID | Severity | Condition | Message | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `css-missing` | warning | File does not exist | Missing block.css — block will have no styles | — |
| `css-no-scope` | error | `.${blockName}` not found anywhere in the file | CSS must be scoped to `.<block-name>` | Prefix selectors with `.<block-name>` |
| `css-reserved-container` | error | `.<block-name>-container` used outside comments | `.<block-name>-container` is auto-generated by EDS on parent section | Use a different suffix like `.<block-name>-inner` |
| `css-wrapper-awareness` | info | `.<block-name>-wrapper` used outside comments | `.<block-name>-wrapper` targets the auto-generated wrapper, not a custom element | — |
| `css-unscoped-element` | error | Bare element selector (`h1–h6`, `p`, `a`, `img`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `div`, `span`, `button`, `input`, `table`, `tr`, `td`, `th`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `header`, `footer`) at the **start** of a rule, not inside a scoped block | Unscoped selector `"<el>"` leaks globally | Change to: `.<block-name> <el> { ... }` |
| `css-important` | warning | `!important` found | !important detected — likely specificity issue | — |
| `css-id-selector` | error | `#<identifier>` appears in selector context (stripped of value declarations, so hex colour values are ignored) | ID selectors are forbidden in block CSS — use classes | — |
| `css-size-budget` | warning | CSS file size > 15 360 bytes | Block CSS is `<N>`KB — recommended under 15KB | — |

---

## Component model rules (`component-models.json` / `_<block-name>.json`)

| Rule ID | Severity | Condition | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| `json-parse` | error | File is not valid JSON | Invalid JSON — cannot parse model file |
| `json-id-missing` | error | Top-level `id` field absent | Missing "id" field in component model |
| `json-id-mismatch` | warning | `id` value ≠ block name | Model id `"<id>"` does not match block name `"<block-name>"` |
| `json-fields-missing` | error | `fields` key absent or not an array | Missing or invalid "fields" array |
| `json-field-name-missing` | error | A field object has no `name` property | Field missing "name" property |
| `json-field-component-missing` | error | A field object has no `component` property | Field `"<name>"` missing "component" property |
| `json-field-component-unknown` | warning | `component` value not in allowed list | Field `"<name>"` has unknown component type `"<type>"` |

**Allowed `component` values:**

```
text, textarea,
text-input, text-area, richtext, reference, aem-content,
select, multiselect, boolean, number, date-input, container, tab
```

---

## Sample-content rules (`sample-content.md` / `content` file)

| Rule ID | Severity | Condition | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content-header-name` | warning | First row does not contain the title-cased block name (e.g. `\| Insurance Plan Card \|`) or the kebab-cased name (e.g. `\| insurance-plan-card \|`) | First row should contain the block name |
| `content-table-separator` | error | Neither `\| --- \|` nor `\|---\|` found | Missing table separator row `"\| --- \|"` |

---

## README rules

| Rule ID | Severity | Condition | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| `readme-missing` | warning | `README.md` absent from block folder | README.md is missing — add authoring documentation |

---

## Scoring

$$\text{score} = \max\!\bigl(0,\; 100 - \text{errors} \times 15 - \text{warnings} \times 5 - \text{infos} \times 2\bigr)$$

A block **passes** (`passed = true`) when `errors.length === 0`.

---

## Checklist for PR review

- [ ] `<block>.js` exports exactly one `export default function decorate(block)`
- [ ] All DOM queries use `block.querySelector` / `block.querySelectorAll`
- [ ] No framework imports (React, Vue, Angular)
- [ ] No npm bare imports
- [ ] No `document.write`, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`
- [ ] `<block>.css` scopes every rule under `.<block-name>`
- [ ] No bare element selectors leaking globally
- [ ] No ID selectors in CSS
- [ ] `component-models.json` has correct `id` and valid `fields`
- [ ] Sample content table has block-name header row and `| --- |` separator
- [ ] `README.md` present
- [ ] JS ≤ 10 KB, CSS ≤ 15 KB
